_simulated: Mock report and trip records for the hackathon. Not a real trip.
_data_quality_notes: Driver GPS is recorded at arrival and through 09:02 only. There are no GPS samples from after 09:02 through cancellation at 09:08.
App timer events measure elapsed time, not physical presence. The gap does not establish whether the driver stayed or left.
No rider location, photo or call recording is available. Chat statements and the driver statement are unverified party accounts.

dispute.description: I went to the booked pickup bay at Tiong Bahru Plaza but could not find the car. At 09:03 I messaged the driver, who said they were still waiting. I called at 09:05 but we did not connect. At 09:08 the trip was cancelled and I was charged $5.00. I believe the driver had left and want the fee reversed.
dispute.driver_statement: I arrived at the booked pickup bay at 09:00 and stayed until 09:08. My app lost its location connection, but I did not leave. I tried to contact the rider and could not find them.

chat_logs.content: I have arrived at the pickup bay.
I am at the booked bay but cannot see your car. Have you left?
I am still at the pickup bay. My app location is not updating.
In-app call to rider rang for 20 seconds; no connection established.
In-app call to driver rang for 20 seconds; no connection established.
I still cannot find you. Please tell me exactly where you are.
I am waiting at the bay and will cancel when the timer reaches eight minutes.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $5.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7825 booked TRIP-2026-09947 from Tiong Bahru Plaza pickup bay to VivoCity. Scheduled pickup 09:00.
GPS recorded the driver at the booked pickup coordinates.
Five-minute free wait ends at 09:05. Eight-minute no-show threshold ends at 09:08.

Driver GPS was recorded from 09:00 through 09:02 only. No subsequent GPS samples were stored before cancellation at 09:08. Presence during that gap is unknown; elapsed timer values do not establish whether the driver stayed or left.
Five minutes elapsed since arrival. Timer does not verify the driver's current position.
Driver cancelled with reason rider_no_show after eight elapsed minutes. Driver position at cancellation unavailable.
$5.00 no-show cancellation fee charged to the rider.
